notes: Sites: examples/prompts/plan.md:20 (find behind head), :24 (|| true behind tail). Fork the note parked is already ruled — spec/prompt.md *Why: the measured transport facts* rejects per-span tolerance, naming both example chains' spans as digests whose failure means a blind tick.
